landing.title: SafeVoice
landing.subtitle: A safe, private way to tell someone what happened.
consent.title: Before you start
consent.point1: You can tell us what happened by speaking.
consent.point2: Nothing is saved until you agree.
consent.point3: We will not ask for your name.
consent.point4: You can stop at any time.
consent.point5: A computer program turns your voice into text and helps judge how urgent your report is. A trained case worker always reads or listens to your report.
consent.point6: Your report is kept private and is deleted after 24 months.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.session: Your session has ended. Please start again.
record.title: Tell us what happened
record.hint: Press the button and speak. Take your time. You can listen back before you send.
record.tooShort: That was too short. Please try again and speak a little longer.
record.denied: We cannot use your microphone. Allow the microphone in your browser settings, then try again.
record.unsupported: This phone or browser cannot record voice.
details.title: A few quick questions
details.incident: What happened? Choose all that apply. You can skip this.
details.when: When did it happen? You can skip this.
details.error: Your report was not sent. Please try again.
done.title: Your report was sent
done.codeHint: Write this code down. It is the only way to check on your report. It will not be shown again.
